title: CBIC Revises Customs Tariff Values for Gold, Silver, Oils, and Areca Nuts
content:
# CBIC Revises Customs Tariff Values for Gold, Silver, Oils, and Areca Nuts

Ek important update hai! The Central Board of Indirect Taxes & Customs (CBIC) has announced revisions to the Customs Tariff Values for several key commodities including Gold, Silver, specified Oils, and Areca Nuts. This change has been brought in via Notification No. 71/2026-Customs (N.T.) dated August 25, 2026.

Here are the key details you should know:

*   **Notification Reference:** The revisions are introduced through Notification No. 71/2026-Customs (N.T.) dated August 25, 2026.
*   **Effective Date:** This notification came into force with effect from August 26, 2026.
*   **Amendment:** The notification amends Notification No. 36/2001-Customs (N.T.) dated August 3, 2001, by substituting Table-1, Table-2, and Table-3 which prescribe the tariff values for various imported goods.
*   **Key Changes in Tariff Values (in USD):**
    *   **Gold:** For gold covered under serial number 194 of Notification No. 45/2025-Customs, the tariff value is set at US$1,500 per 10 grams. This value also applies to specified gold bars, gold coins, and gold findings, subject to exclusions mentioned in the notification.
    *   **Silver:** Silver covered under serial number 195 of Notification No. 45/2025-Customs, and other specified forms of silver, retain a tariff value of US$2,097 per kilogram (i.e., no change).
    *   **Oils:** Tariff values for crude palm oil, RBD palm oil, other palm oil, crude palmolein, RBD palmolein, other palmolein, and crude soybean oil remain unchanged.
    *   **Areca Nuts:** The tariff value for areca nuts also remains unchanged at US$11,574 per metric tonne.
    *   **Brass Scrap:** The tariff value for brass scrap remains at US$7,945 per metric tonne (no change).
